observations_after_inspection: Many small plots separated by low banks fill the foreground and middle distance: evidence that the land is cultivated (agriculture).
An unsealed track runs up through the plots from the bottom of the image, giving access to them.
Some plots hold water or green growth. The image cannot show the crop, whether the water is irrigation or rain, or whether the farming is commercial.
independent_solution: bounded plots with growth or water, reached by a track (1)
crop, water source and purpose not established (1)
